html:
The Euphrasian Basilica is a church in Poreč on the Istrian coast of Croatia, built in the mid 500s by Bishop Euphrasius on the site of earlier churches.

Its apse mosaics, in gold and colour, are among the finest from the age of Justinian outside Ravenna and Constantinople, showing the Virgin and Child with saints and the bishop himself holding a model of his church. The complex keeps its atrium, baptistery and bishop's palace, which makes it one of the best preserved early Christian sites in the Mediterranean. Istria was then under the Byzantine empire; it later passed to Venice for centuries. The basilica is a World Heritage Site.
sum: The Euphrasian Basilica is a church in Poreč on the Istrian coast of Croatia, built in the mid 500s by Bishop Euphrasius on the site of earlier churches.
